basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old music producer living in Austin, Texas. My passion lies in creating electronic dance music, and I've been doing it as a hobby for the past five years. I enjoy experimenting with new sounds and techniques, and I release my tracks independently. By day, I work as an audio engineer at a local studio. In my free time, I love exploring new music genres, collecting vinyl records, and occasionally binge-watching shows like Hannibal. I'm currently single and often online in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in audio engineering, which I studied at a local community college. Over the years, I've honed my skills through self-teaching and practical experience, working with various artists and participating in online music production forums.
